metadata.title: Massive perturbers in the galactic center

notes: Empty roster: the paper discusses only stellar populations and unnamed modeled objects. It gives no individual star identifier and does not explicitly identify or retain any star as a present-day Galactic unbound candidate. The “hyper-velocity B stars at the edge of the Galaxy” (T:p1-b6) and predicted “young hyper velocity stars” (T:p8-b5) are population references, not identified stars; the S-cluster discussion (T:p7-b2, T:p8-b3) concerns stars captured near the MBH.
